title: Railway to be fenced.
bodyText: The corporation shall fence in the line of railway with a good and sufficient legal fence.
bodyHtml: §273-12  Railway to be fenced.  The corporation shall fence in the line of railway with a good and sufficient legal fence. [L 1878, c 29, §23; RL 1915, §899; RL 1935, §1805; RL 1945, §5063; RL 1955, §106-12; HRS §273-12]
